titles.zh: 尼泊尔—西藏山洪造成大规模失联，救援受阻
titles.en: Hundreds Missing as Nepal–Tibet Flood Rescue Faces Severe Obstacles

items.originalTitle: 'Extremely challenging' conditions hamper Nepal-Tibet flood rescue efforts

summaries.zh: 尼泊尔和西藏遭遇灾难性山洪后，超过千人据报失联。恶劣天气、山区地形和基础设施损毁阻碍跨国救援，部分灾区与加德满都失去联系。
summaries.en: More than 1,000 people were reported missing after catastrophic flash flooding struck Nepal and Tibet. International rescue teams faced severe weather, mountainous terrain and damaged or inadequate infrastructure, while some devastated communities said they had been cut off from Kathmandu. Reports from France 24, DW and the BBC independently described the scale of the search and the difficulties reaching survivors.

whyItMatters.zh: 高伤亡风险与交通中断暴露出喜马拉雅地区预警和灾害响应能力的缺口。
whyItMatters.en: The disaster exposes major gaps in Himalayan early-warning systems, resilient infrastructure and cross-border emergency response.

titles.zh: 刚果（金）埃博拉病例上升，联合国呼吁紧急投入
titles.en: UN Calls for Urgent Action as Ebola Cases Rise in DR Congo

items.originalTitle: UN chief condemns “indifference” as Ebola cases mount in DR Congo

summaries.zh: 联合国秘书长表示，刚果（金）的本迪布焦型埃博拉疫情正在令人警觉地扩散，亟须资金和行动。法国媒体另报当地传播仍活跃，而乌干达相关疫情已经结束。
summaries.en: The UN Secretary-General called for urgent action and funding as the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak spread in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. France 24 separately reported that transmission remained active in the country even as Uganda declared its outbreak over. The supplied figures originate with Congolese authorities, but the need for an escalating response is supported by both reports.

whyItMatters.zh: 持续传播可能造成更多死亡并考验区域卫生系统与国际应急资金。
whyItMatters.en: Continued transmission threatens more deaths while testing regional health capacity and international outbreak financing.

titles.zh: 波黑种族灭绝罪犯拉特科·姆拉迪奇在羁押中去世
titles.en: Convicted Bosnia Genocide Commander Ratko Mladic Dies in Custody

items.originalTitle: Ratko Mladic, former general convicted of Bosnia genocide, dies

summaries.zh: 因策划斯雷布雷尼察大屠杀等罪行而被判终身监禁的前波黑塞族将领拉特科·姆拉迪奇，84岁时在荷兰一所联合国监狱医院去世。
summaries.en: Ratko Mladic, the former Bosnian Serb commander serving a life sentence for genocide and other crimes committed during the 1992–95 Bosnian war, died aged 84 in a UN prison hospital in the Netherlands. France 24, Al Jazeera and ABC News Australia independently reported his death, citing confirmation associated with the UN tribunal in The Hague.

whyItMatters.zh: 他的死亡结束了巴尔干战争司法追责中最具象征性的羁押案件之一。
whyItMatters.en: His death closes one of the most consequential custodial cases arising from international prosecution of the Balkan wars.

titles.zh: 欧足联拟就世界杯权益出售计划起诉因凡蒂诺
titles.en: UEFA Moves Toward Criminal Complaint Against FIFA President Infantino

items.originalTitle: UEFA to bring criminal complaint against Infantino

summaries.zh: 欧足联表示正准备针对国际足联主席詹尼·因凡蒂诺提出刑事控告，争议涉及其未能完成的世界杯权益出售计划，并已向美国法院索取相关文件。
summaries.en: UEFA said it was preparing a criminal complaint against FIFA president Gianni Infantino over a failed plan to sell a stake connected to the World Cup. Al Jazeera reported that European football’s governing body had also asked a US court for FIFA documents. The two independent reports establish UEFA’s legal preparations, while no criminal finding has been made.

whyItMatters.zh: 争议可能引发对全球足球最高管理层决策、资产处置和问责机制的司法审查。
whyItMatters.en: The dispute could bring judicial scrutiny to decision-making, asset transactions and accountability at the top of global football.

titles.zh: “擎天柱”配音演员彼得·库伦去世，享年85岁
titles.en: Peter Cullen, Voice of Optimus Prime, Dies at 85

items.originalTitle: Peter Cullen, Optimus Prime in Transformers, Dies at 85

summaries.zh: 加拿大演员彼得·库伦去世，享年85岁。他最广为人知的角色是《变形金刚》擎天柱，也曾为小熊维尼中的屹耳以及多部电影生物角色配音。
summaries.en: Canadian actor Peter Cullen died at 85. He was best known as the defining voice of Optimus Prime across the Transformers franchise and also performed Eeyore and numerous other animation and creature roles. IGN and The Hollywood Reporter, belonging to different publisher groups, independently reported his death and described a career that shaped several generations of popular entertainment.

whyItMatters.zh: 库伦塑造了全球最具辨识度的动画声音之一，其表演影响跨越影视、玩具与游戏。
whyItMatters.en: Cullen created one of popular culture’s most recognizable voices, with an influence spanning film, television, toys and games.

titles.zh: 宇航员乔尼·金离开NASA，继续在美国海军服役
titles.en: Astronaut Jonny Kim Leaves NASA to Continue US Navy Service

items.originalTitle: NASA Astronaut Jonny Kim Departs Agency to Continue Military Service

summaries.zh: NASA宣布，宇航员乔尼·金在该机构近十年的任职于当天结束，之后将继续以海军少校身份服役。他此前曾在国际空间站执行约八个月的科研任务。
summaries.en: NASA announced that astronaut Jonny Kim’s final day at the agency was August 27 after nearly a decade of service. Kim will continue serving as a lieutenant commander in the US Navy. His NASA career included an approximately eight-month science expedition aboard the International Space Station after launching on Soyuz MS-27 in April 2025.

whyItMatters.zh: 这项人员变动使一名具长期空间站任务经验的宇航员离开美国民用航天队伍。
whyItMatters.en: The departure removes an astronaut with long-duration station experience from the US civilian spaceflight corps.

titles.zh: 自闭症相关突变被发现汇聚性重塑蛋白互作网络
titles.en: Autism-Linked Mutations Converge on Rewired Protein Interaction Networks

items.originalTitle: Autism mutations rewire protein interaction networks to drive neurodevelopmental pathology

summaries.zh: 研究绘制100个高可信自闭症相关基因的蛋白互作网络，记录逾1800项互作，并发现不同致病突变可汇聚到共同蛋白复合体与神经发育异常。
summaries.en: Researchers mapped protein interactions for 100 high-confidence autism-associated genes, identifying more than 1,800 interactions. Tests of pathogenic missense variants suggested that distinct mutations can converge on shared protein complexes and rewire interaction networks. Work in human-derived models linked FOXP1 variants to altered cortical neurogenesis and neural activity, providing a possible bridge from genetic variation to convergent neurodevelopmental dysfunction.

whyItMatters.zh: 共同受扰的蛋白网络可能为高度异质的自闭症遗传风险提供统一的机制研究方向。
whyItMatters.en: Shared disrupted protein networks could provide a unifying mechanistic direction for studying genetically diverse forms of autism.

pendingReason.zh: 目前只有Science论文及同DOI的Crossref摘要，缺少独立允许来源对研究结果的评议。
pendingReason.en: Only the Science paper and same-DOI Crossref abstract are available; independent allowlisted evaluation is missing.

titles.zh: AI硬件需求挤压供应，Android将收紧应用内存限制
titles.en: Android Tightens App Memory Limits Amid AI-Driven Hardware Pressure

items.originalTitle: AI’s memory crunch is coming for Android apps

summaries.zh: TechCrunch报道，谷歌正在为Android应用设置新的内存使用限制。报道将此举与AI数据中心推动的硬件短缺联系起来，低价手机可能因此配置更少内存。
summaries.en: Google is introducing new memory-use limits for Android applications, according to TechCrunch. The report links the change to hardware supply pressure associated with rapidly expanding AI data centers, which could leave lower-cost phones with less memory. Developers may consequently need to reduce application footprints or change how resource-intensive features operate on entry-level devices.

whyItMatters.zh: 数据中心与消费电子争夺内存，可能把AI基础设施扩张的成本传导给手机用户和开发者。
whyItMatters.en: Competition for memory between data centers and consumer devices could shift part of AI infrastructure’s cost to phone users and developers.

pendingReason.zh: 目前仅有TechCrunch报道，缺少谷歌相关公告或另一家独立允许来源确认限制细节及供应链因果关系。
pendingReason.en: Only TechCrunch reports this; a relevant Google announcement or second independent allowlisted source confirming the limits and supply-chain link is missing.

titles.zh: AI数据中心用水影响取决于选址与冷却方式
titles.en: AI’s Water Impact Varies Sharply by Location and Cooling Design

items.originalTitle: How much of a problem is AI’s water use?

summaries.zh: Ars Technica报道，AI基础设施的总体用水足迹正在增长，但实际环境压力因数据中心所在地、水源状况以及采用的冷却技术而显著不同。
summaries.en: AI’s water footprint is increasing, but its environmental cost varies substantially with geography and cooling technology, Ars Technica reported. Data centers operating in water-stressed locations can create different consequences from facilities using less water-intensive cooling or operating where supplies are more resilient. The snapshot provides only this high-level finding, so specific consumption estimates cannot be independently evaluated.

whyItMatters.zh: 地方水资源条件决定AI扩张是否会与居民、农业和生态用水形成高风险竞争。
whyItMatters.en: Local water conditions determine whether AI expansion creates serious competition with households, agriculture and ecosystems.

pendingReason.zh: 目前只有Ars Technica的单篇分析，缺少独立允许来源或原始用水数据核对其范围与量化结论。
pendingReason.en: Only one Ars Technica analysis is available; independent allowlisted coverage or primary water-use data is missing.

titles.zh: 加拿大诱发地震研究识别三种破裂成核路径
titles.en: Study Identifies Three Nucleation Pathways in Injection-Induced Earthquakes

items.originalTitle: Foreshock productivity and rupture nucleation in injection-induced earthquakes in western Canada

summaries.zh: 研究分析加拿大西部2014至2024年的77组注入诱发地震序列，发现多数三级以上主震前出现前震，并提出流体驱动预滑与级联等三种成核模型。
summaries.en: An analysis of 77 injection-induced earthquake sequences in western Canada found that 92% of magnitude-three-or-greater mainshocks were preceded by foreshocks. The researchers identified three nucleation models involving fluid-driven preslip or cascading rupture and concluded that monitoring should account for spatial differences in foreshock productivity. The evidence comes from the paper’s enriched abstract and has not been independently assessed here.

whyItMatters.zh: 若得到进一步验证，这些模式可帮助改进工业流体注入项目的地震风险预警。
whyItMatters.en: If independently validated, the patterns could improve seismic warning protocols around industrial fluid-injection operations.

pendingReason.zh: 目前仅有Science论文及同DOI的Crossref元数据，缺少独立允许来源的研究解读。
pendingReason.en: Only the Science paper and same-DOI Crossref metadata are available; independent allowlisted interpretation is missing.

titles.zh: 单晶金属直接蒸镀降低二维半导体接触电阻
titles.en: Directly Evaporated Single-Crystal Contacts Improve 2D Semiconductors

items.originalTitle: Direct evaporation of single-crystal metal contacts for 2D semiconductors

summaries.zh: 研究人员开发原子尺度逐步蒸镀方法，在单层半导体上直接生长界面洁净的多种单晶金属。实验器件显示低接触电阻、稳定功函数和较强热稳定性。
summaries.en: Researchers developed an atomic-scale, stepwise evaporation process that directly grows single-crystal metals on monolayer semiconductors while suppressing secondary nucleation. The resulting contacts supported ultrathin conduction, uniform work functions and improved thermal robustness. Bismuth and palladium contacts produced low contact resistance and high short-channel currents in molybdenum-disulfide and tungsten-diselenide transistors, according to the paper’s abstract.

whyItMatters.zh: 更优金属接触可能缓解二维材料从实验器件走向高性能电子产品的关键瓶颈。
whyItMatters.en: Better electrical contacts could remove a major obstacle to turning two-dimensional materials into practical high-performance electronics.

pendingReason.zh: 目前只有Science论文记录，缺少另一家独立允许来源对结果和局限性的报道或验证。
pendingReason.en: Only the Science paper record is available; independent allowlisted coverage assessing the result and its limitations is missing.

titles.zh: 南非涉黑人物在警务腐败调查委员会作证
titles.en: Alleged Underworld Figure Testifies at South African Corruption Inquiry

items.originalTitle: Alleged underworld kingpin testifies at S. African commission

summaries.zh: 一名被指为地下犯罪头目的人士在南非马德兰加委员会完成作证。该委员会正调查包括停职警察高官涉嫌从犯罪分子收受回扣在内的多项指控。
summaries.en: Vusimusi “Cat” Matlala, described in the report as an alleged underworld figure, completed testimony before South Africa’s Madlanga Commission. The inquiry is examining allegations that include claims a suspended deputy police chief received kickbacks from criminals. The description establishes the hearing but does not independently prove the underlying allegations, which should remain treated as claims under investigation.

whyItMatters.zh: 调查触及有组织犯罪与高级警务人员可能勾连的问题，关系到执法机构的公信力。
whyItMatters.en: The inquiry addresses possible links between organized crime and senior police officials, directly affecting trust in law enforcement.

pendingReason.zh: 目前仅有France 24报道，缺少委员会记录或第二家独立允许来源确认作证内容。
pendingReason.en: Only France 24 reports this; commission records or a second independent allowlisted account confirming the testimony are missing.

titles.zh: 挪威国王哈拉尔五世病情据报恶化
titles.en: Norway’s King Harald Reported in Very Serious Condition

items.originalTitle: Norway holds its breath as King Harald's health deteriorates

summaries.zh: 法国24台援引挪威王室称，89岁的哈拉尔五世国王在医院处于“非常严重”状态，王室成员已聚集在床边，民众则在奥斯陆王宫外献花等候消息。
summaries.en: Norway’s 89-year-old King Harald was in a “very serious” condition in hospital, France 24 reported, attributing that characterization to the royal court. Family members gathered at his bedside, while members of the public assembled outside the Royal Palace in Oslo and left flowers. The snapshot contains no diagnosis or further clinical detail.

whyItMatters.zh: 国王健康若进一步恶化，可能触发挪威王室职责安排和国家仪式层面的变化。
whyItMatters.en: A further deterioration could affect royal duties and initiate consequential constitutional and ceremonial arrangements in Norway.

pendingReason.zh: 目前仅有France 24援引王室的报道，缺少王室直接声明或第二家独立允许来源确认最新状况。
pendingReason.en: Only France 24’s report citing the royal court is available; a direct court statement or second independent allowlisted confirmation is missing.

titles.zh: 柏林附近学校发生暴力事件，两人死亡
titles.en: Two Killed in Violent Incident at School Near Berlin

items.originalTitle: Two killed in 'violent incident' at school near Berlin

summaries.zh: BBC报道，柏林附近一所学校发生暴力事件，造成两人死亡，其中一名死者18岁。警方已逮捕一名男子；快照没有提供其动机或更完整案情。
summaries.en: Two people were killed in what police described as a violent incident at a school near Berlin, the BBC reported. One victim was 18 years old, and police arrested a man following the incident. The supplied RSS description does not establish a motive, the relationship between those involved or whether authorities identified any continuing threat.

whyItMatters.zh: 校园内发生致命暴力将引发对当地安全措施、受害者支持和案件动机的持续调查。
whyItMatters.en: Fatal violence at a school will prompt scrutiny of local security, victim support and the still-unknown motive.

pendingReason.zh: 目前只有BBC报道，缺少警方等相关主要来源或第二家独立允许媒体确认案情细节。
pendingReason.en: Only the BBC report is available; a relevant police source or second independent allowlisted report confirming the details is missing.

titles.zh: Xbox实体光盘将可授予对应游戏数字访问权
titles.en: Xbox Discs to Grant Digital Access Under New Preservation Policy

items.originalTitle: Xbox discs will now grant digital access to games as part of Microsoft's self-proclaimed 'broader commitment to game preservation'

summaries.zh: PC Gamer报道，微软将允许Xbox实体光盘授予对应游戏的数字访问权，并把这项变化称为更广泛游戏保存承诺的一部分。具体兼容范围尚未说明。
summaries.en: Microsoft will allow Xbox game discs to grant digital access to their corresponding titles, PC Gamer reported, presenting the change as part of a broader commitment to game preservation. The policy could help owners retain access as hardware and distribution methods evolve. The brief RSS description does not specify eligible consoles, supported titles, transfer rules or long-term authentication requirements.

whyItMatters.zh: 实体介质与数字授权的绑定方式会直接影响玩家所有权、向后兼容和长期游戏保存。
whyItMatters.en: How physical media maps to digital licenses directly affects ownership, backward compatibility and long-term game preservation.

pendingReason.zh: 目前仅有PC Gamer报道，缺少微软主要来源或另一家独立允许媒体确认适用范围和授权条件。
pendingReason.en: Only PC Gamer reports the policy; a Microsoft primary source or second independent allowlisted report confirming its scope and licensing conditions is missing.

titles.zh: 壁虎基因组揭示性染色体演化并非随机
titles.en: Gecko Genomes Suggest Sex-Chromosome Evolution Follows Genomic Constraints

items.originalTitle: Genomic predisposition is associated with the direction of sex chromosome evolution

summaries.zh: 研究比较19种壁虎的染色体级基因组，发现性染色体多次独立起源，但形成XY或ZW系统的方向与祖先基因组成及环境背景存在关联。
summaries.en: Researchers compared chromosome-level genomes from 19 gecko species and found that sex chromosomes arose independently from 16 ancestral chromosomes. Their origins appeared nonrandom: ancestral gene content was associated with whether lineages evolved XY or ZW systems, and several dated origins clustered near a past climatic transition. The study also found repeated partial dosage balancing in species with genetic sex determination.

whyItMatters.zh: 结果为解释脊椎动物性别决定系统为何沿不同方向演化提供了可检验框架。
whyItMatters.en: The findings offer a testable framework for why vertebrate sex-determination systems repeatedly evolve in different directions.

pendingReason.zh: 目前仅有Science论文及同DOI的Crossref元数据，尚无第二家独立允许来源评估结论。
pendingReason.en: Only the Science paper and same-DOI Crossref metadata are available; a second independent allowlisted assessment is missing.

titles.en: Prime Video Greenlights Six-Part Crouch End Limited Series

items.originalTitle: Prime Video Sets Series Adaptation Of Stephen King Short Story ‘Crouch End’

summaries.en: Prime Video has greenlit a six-part limited series based on Stephen King’s short story Crouch End, Deadline reported. The adaptation will retain the story’s title and be produced in the United Kingdom. The supplied description confirms a binding commissioning decision but does not include a release date, cast, production schedule or financial terms.

whyItMatters.zh: 正式立项为斯蒂芬·金作品新增一项流媒体改编，也为英国电视制作带来确定项目。
whyItMatters.en: The commission adds another major streaming adaptation of Stephen King’s work and creates a confirmed UK production.

pendingReason.en: Only Variety reports the deal; an announcement from the parties or second independent allowlisted source confirming its scope and release plan is missing.

journalHighlights.originalTitle: A necroptotic-to-apoptotic signaling axis underlies inflammatory bowel disease

titles.zh: 坏死性凋亡向细胞凋亡的信号轴或驱动炎症性肠病复发
titles.en: Cell-Death Signaling Axis May Drive Inflammatory Bowel Disease Relapse

summaries.zh: 研究发现，异常上皮细胞死亡信号在炎症性肠病早期出现，即使患者缓解或接受先进治疗仍可持续，并能预测临床复发。
summaries.en: Researchers identified abnormal epithelial cell-death signaling as a persistent feature of inflammatory bowel disease. Early inflammation pushed epithelial cells toward a macrophage-like transcriptional state, promoting necroptotic signaling that subsequently triggered apoptosis in absorptive cells and intestinal stem-cell death. The mechanism appeared in patients in remission and receiving advanced therapy and was associated with later clinical relapse.

whyItMatters.zh: 持续存在的细胞死亡通路可能解释现有治疗后复发，并提供新的生物标志物和干预靶点。
whyItMatters.en: A persistent cell-death pathway could help explain relapse after current treatment and offer biomarkers or new therapeutic targets.

notice.zh: 本条依据同一DOI的Crossref增强元数据整理；Crossref不构成独立佐证。
notice.en: This highlight uses Crossref-enriched metadata for the same DOI; Crossref is not independent corroboration.

journalHighlights.originalTitle: Why are El Niños getting stronger? 1000-year-coral record points to climate change

titles.zh: 千年珊瑚记录为厄尔尼诺增强提供气候变化证据
titles.en: Thousand-Year Coral Record Links Stronger El Niños to Climate Change

summaries.zh: 一项基于千年珊瑚记录的太平洋海表温度重建，为人为变暖正在增强厄尔尼诺事件的观点增添了新的长期证据。
summaries.en: A reconstruction of Pacific sea-surface temperatures based on a thousand-year coral record adds evidence that human-caused warming is strengthening El Niño events. The long record provides context beyond the relatively short instrumental era, helping researchers compare recent variability with earlier centuries. The supplied Nature RSS description does not provide methodological details or quantified estimates of the change.

whyItMatters.zh: 更强的厄尔尼诺可能扩大跨区域极端天气、粮食与水资源风险。
